about: Shared check table for how defrecord / defwire fields are read. Both the Hy-side source of truth doeff_hy._declarations/field-targets (defrecord, defwire) and the Rust-side source of truth doeff-indexer's hy_index::fields::record_field_targets (hy-index's record_def, doeff-linter's DOEFF204) read this table, which confirms they give the same answer. forms is the list of forms in the record body; names is the field names in written order (as spelled).

cases.forms: (setv #^ int a 0 x 1 #^ (| str None) c None)
